mapper.sql: E.DSPT_EXEC_SN, E.JOB_ID, J.JOB_NM, J.WRK_MDUL_CD, E.JOB_EXEC_ID, E.EXEC_CLS_CD, E.EXEC_STAT_CD, E.EXEC_ST_DTTM, E.EXEC_END_DTTM, E.PROC_CNT, E.SUCC_CNT, E.FAIL_CNT, E.ERR_MSG_CONT, E.EXEC_SRV_NM, E.FIRS_REGR_ID
mapper.select: /* BatchExecutionMapper.selectBatchExecutionCount 검색 조건에 맞는 실행 이력 전체 건수를 조회한다. */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DSPT_EXEC_L E JOIN TB_DSPT_JOB_M J ON J.JOB_ID = E.JOB_ID
mapper.update: /* BatchExecutionMapper.updateBatchExecution JOB_EXEC_ID 기준으로 종료 정보(상태, 종료일시, 건수, 오류메시지)를 갱신한다. */ UPDATE TB_DSPT_EXEC_L SET EXEC_STAT_CD = #{execStatCd}, EXEC_END_DTTM = #{execEndDttm}, PROC_CNT = #{procCnt}, SUCC_CNT = #{succCnt}, FAIL_CNT = #{failCnt}, ERR_MSG_CONT = #{errMsgCont}, FINA_REGR_ID = #{finaRegrId}, FINA_REG_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE JOB_EXEC_ID = #{jobExecId}
